calls.statement:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS d, MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_all, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_orders
FROM fact_web_order

WITH o AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT o.status,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN o.web_order_id END) AS test_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 999 THEN o.web_order_id END) AS s999_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS with_lines
FROM o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
  AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS utc_date_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
